label: Google Ads
terms_note: Google Ads API requires a developer token with access levels (Google Ads API policies page linked from the docs); console ToS not read this session

discovery.auth: oauth2 + developer-token header (+ login-customer-id for manager accounts)
sdks: https://developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/client-libs (official client libraries: Java, .NET, PHP, Python, Ruby, Perl)

auth: 1. Tenant (or platform) has a Google Ads **manager** account → API Center → apply for a developer token (starts at Test Account Access).

2. OAuth 2.0 web flow on the user's Google account with scope `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords` (sensitive → OAuth app verification: verified domain, privacy policy on that domain, demo video).

3. Every call: `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>`, `developer-token: <token>`, `login-customer-id: <manager id digits>` when acting through a manager; optional `linked-customer-id` for linked accounts.

4. Access levels (developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/access-levels): Test (15,000 ops/day, test accounts only) → Explorer (2,880 ops/day production, automatic in some cases; no account creation / billing / planning) → Basic (15,000 ops/day, 5 business days) → Standard (unlimited, 10 business

endpoints.notes: `{query: GAQL}` — `FROM campaign / ad_group / ad_group_ad / keyword_view / search_term_view / change_event`, `metrics.*`, `segments.date`
`create{name, advertising_channel_type, campaign_budget, status, bidding strategy fields, network_settings}` / `update`

reference.limits: - Quotas per developer token per sliding 24 h (see access levels); `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` when exceeded; 10,000 mutate operations per request (`TOO_MANY_MUTATE_OPERATIONS`); fixed 10,000-row pages on `googleAds:search` (no page_size since v19). - Free API; the Google Ads API Terms and Required Minimum Functionality apply to tools that serve third parties (Standard access). - Policy: ads.google.com policies apply to created ads; `validate_only` dry runs required by our rule before any mutate.
mcp_sdk: Official client libraries: Java, .NET, PHP, Python, Ruby, Perl (developers.google.com/google-ads/api/docs/client-libs). No official MCP server found on the docs; community MCP servers exist but were not opened this pass.

sandbox.notes: Google Ads API has no sandbox host: test accounts are called on googleads.googleapis.com like production accounts. Create a test manager account (a new hierarchy rooted at a test manager; test and production accounts cannot interact), use its customer ids as customer_id / login_customer_id; a developer token with Test access works only against test accounts (production accounts answer CLOUD_PROJECT_NOT_APPROVED_FOR_PRODUCTION / DEVELOPER_TOKEN_NOT_APPROVED). Test accounts serve no ads, so metrics are empty.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: OAuth 2.0 client id (Google Cloud console > Credentials) of the app that the Google Ads user authorised with scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords.

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: The OAuth client's secret; sent in the form body of the refresh_token grant.

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token obtained once through Google's consent flow (offline access, scope https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords); the runtime mints hourly access tokens from it.

fields.name: developer_token
fields.help: Google Ads API developer token (manager account > Admin > API Center), sent as the `developer-token` header on every call; Test-access tokens only work against test accounts.

config_fields.name: customer_id
config_fields.help: Google Ads customer id (10 digits, no dashes) of the account being managed: pause_resume mutates campaigns under it, and list_accounts reads its customer_client hierarchy (itself plus direct clients when it is a manager). When the user reaches it through a manager account, also set login_customer_id.

config_fields.name: login_customer_id
config_fields.help: Manager customer id (digits, no dashes) sent as `login-customer-id` when the user reaches client accounts through a manager account; leave unset for direct access.

me.note: GET /v25/customers:listAccessibleCustomers lists the customers directly accessible with the OAuth token as `resourceNames` (customers/{id}).

body.query: =SELECT customer_client.client_customer, customer_client.level, customer_client.manager, customer_client.descriptive_name, customer_client.currency_code, customer_client.time_zone, customer_client.id FROM customer_client WHERE customer_client.level <= 1

list_accounts.note: googleAds:search on the configured customer_id with the documented account-hierarchy GAQL query (customer_client, level <= 1): the account itself plus its direct clients. Search returns fixed pages of 10,000 rows with a nextPageToken; `page` is not sent.

body.query: =SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, campaign.status, campaign.start_date_time, campaign.end_date_time, campaign_budget.amount_micros FROM campaign WHERE campaign.status != 'REMOVED' ORDER BY campaign.id

list_campaigns.note: POST /v25/customers/{account_id}/googleAds:search with a fixed GAQL query (non-removed campaigns). account_id is the 10-digit customer id without dashes. `status` is not applied (GAQL is a literal; the runtime cannot splice arguments into it); the budget is campaign_budget.amountMicros in raw (micros of the account currency, not mapped to `budget`). One call returns up to 10,000 rows; `page` is not sent.

body.query: fmt:SELECT campaign.id, campaign.name, segments.date, metrics.impressions, metrics.clicks, metrics.cost_micros, metrics.conversions FROM campaign WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '{date:date_from}' AND '{date:date_to}' ORDER BY segments.date

get_report.note: googleAds:search on customers/{account_id} with GAQL `FROM campaign WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '<date_from>' AND '<date_to>'` (dates YYYY-MM-DD, as in the documented custom-range example): one row per campaign per day. cost_micros is the cost in micros of the account currency (divide by 1,000,000); int64 metrics arrive as strings. `campaign_id` is not applied (filter the rows). Up to 10,000 rows (one page).

pause_resume.note: POST /v25/customers/{customer_id (config)}/campaigns:mutate {operations: [{update: {resourceName: customers/{customer_id}/campaigns/{campaign_id}, status: PAUSED|ENABLED}, updateMask: status}]} ("All updates require an `updateMask` field"). The campaign must belong to the configured customer_id; answers {results: [{resourceName}]}.

not_offered.update_budget: campaignBudgets:mutate updates the CampaignBudget resource (customers/{cid}/campaignBudgets/{budget_id}), whose id is not the campaign id and needs a prior GAQL lookup, with amountMicros (amount x 1,000,000); two calls, a composed resource name and a scaled amount.
